howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Guinea Pig Monitor looks after your guinea pigs' health while you are not watching. This is how it works, step by step.

mark.title: Each guinea pig wears a color mark
mark.text: You register each guinea pig with its name, its breed and the color of the mark on its back. That color is how it is recognized.

watch.title: The cage watches and listens
watch.text: A camera watches the guinea pigs, a microphone listens for squeals and a scale weighs the cage.

analyse.title: Artificial intelligence analyses it
analyse.text: Every minute, an Amazon Bedrock vision model measures how much each guinea pig moves and how often it visits the feeder, and sends it to the system.

panel.title: You see it on the dashboard
panel.text: Here you see the status of each guinea pig and the alerts. When you take care of one, mark it as reviewed.

settings.title: Rules and messages
settings.intro: When a guinea pig goes to observed, alert or critical, what the alerts say and how much the assistant can be asked. It applies on saving, nothing restarts.

health.maxEventAgeMinutes.label: Oldest event accepted (minutes)
health.maxEventAgeMinutes.help: Older data is dropped: it came late and no longer says how the guinea pig is.

health.minDetectionConfidence.label: Minimum AI confidence (0 to 1)
health.minDetectionConfidence.help: If the AI is less sure than this about which guinea pig it saw, the window does not count.

health.consecutiveAnomalyWindows.label: Odd windows in a row to observe
health.consecutiveAnomalyWindows.help: How many minutes in a row of odd behavior move it to “Observed”.

health.distressProbability.label: Certainty for a sound alert (0 to 1)
health.distressProbability.help: How sure the classifier must be that it heard a distress squeal.

health.observedToAlertMinutes.label: Minutes observed before an alert
health.observedToAlertMinutes.help: If the odd behavior lasts this long, it goes to “Alert”.

health.alertToCriticalMinutes.label: Minutes in alert before critical
health.alertToCriticalMinutes.help: If it stays in alert this long, it goes to “Critical”.

health.recoveryWindows.label: Normal windows to recover
health.recoveryWindows.help: How many normal minutes in a row it needs to go back to “Normal”.

health.classifierThreshold.label: AI anomaly threshold (0 to 1)
health.classifierThreshold.help: From this probability on, the AI verdict alone marks the window as odd.

health.stillFactor.label: Times stiller than usual
health.stillFactor.help: This many times stiller than usual, and not at the feeder, counts as odd.

health.groupDistanceFactor.label: Times farther from the group
health.groupDistanceFactor.help: This many times farther from the group than usual counts as odd.

health.baselineMinSamples.label: Windows to know a guinea pig
health.baselineMinSamples.help: Normal windows needed before comparing a guinea pig with itself.

health.baselineWarmupSamples.label: Windows to settle its profile
health.baselineWarmupSamples.help: After this, its normal profile changes slowly.

health.weightDropPercent.label: Weight drop to alert (%)
health.weightDropPercent.help: If the cage weighs this percent less than the days before, an alert goes out.

health.weightRecentHours.label: Recent hours for the weight
health.weightRecentHours.help: The weight now is worked out from these last hours.

health.weightBaselineDays.label: Previous days to compare
health.weightBaselineDays.help: How many days before it is compared with.

health.weightMinReadings.label: Minimum weight readings
health.weightMinReadings.help: Stable readings needed in each period to compare.

message.alert.label: Text of an alert
message.alert.help: What the breeder reads when a guinea pig goes to “Alert”.

message.critical.label: Text of a critical alert
message.critical.help: What they read when it goes to “Critical”.

message.distress.label: Text of the sound alert
message.distress.help: What they read when distress squeals are heard.

message.weightDrop.label: Text of the weight alert
message.weightDrop.help: What they read when the cage gets lighter. {porcentaje} becomes the drop.

assistant.maxQuestions.label: Questions per account to the assistant
assistant.maxQuestions.help: Most questions to Cuchi in the window below. 0 = no limit.

assistant.windowMinutes.label: Limit window (minutes)
assistant.windowMinutes.help: The period those questions are counted in.

settings.saved: Done, the new rules apply now.
settings.saveFailed: Not saved: a value is out of its range. Check the limits.
settings.resetExplain: Every rule, text and the assistant limit go back to how they came. It applies at once.
